statements.status_notes: Waiting for upstream fix. The available upstream fix is Vault 2.0.0. That is a major version upgrade and is intentionally not adopted here.

Not affected: the vulnerable code is not present because this image backports the upstream release/1.21.x fix from hashicorp/vault commit a9f3864a31cd29ec6feea7249a0467ef34faf021, which rejects unsafe ACME HTTP-01 and TLS-ALPN-01 validation targets before challenge verification connects to them. Remove this VEX when the image tracks Vault 1.21.5 or later.

Not affected: the vulnerable code is not present because this image backports the upstream release/1.21.x fix from hashicorp/vault commit e93d962d2ae91afdc3f950e16c6e3fe5626fd846, which strips Vault tokens from Authorization passthrough headers before forwarding to plugin backends. Remove this VEX when the image tracks Vault 1.21.5 or later.

Not affected: the vulnerable code is not present because this image backports the upstream release/1.21.x fix from hashicorp/vault commit a9c424da0250c4e7cbdf221e9a5d92130775e92c, which rejects globs and directory wildcards rendered from identity ACL templates. Remove this VEX when the image tracks Vault 1.21.5 or later.
